about: The shadow lab (2026-11-24, the operator's approval): pre-registered experiments graded on real results, with no entries needed. Every kept lineup of a saved bank (entered or not) gets its real finish percentile in each of the slate's graded contests; an experiment's treatment lineups are compared to its control lineups from the SAME slate and contest (paired). Written by scripts/dk_eval.py lab (run by ideas, nightly); the definitions below are fixed before the first counted slate and only 'results' is rewritten.

method.unit: a slate (draft group) with a saved bank, a record and at least one graded contest of LAB_MIN_ENTRIES (100) entries or more; a slate on or after the experiment's registration date counts toward its planned nights, earlier slates are a look-back only
method.lineups: the bank's kept lineups (final), entered or not; a lineup drawn under several tags counts for each of them (the ideas grade's shared-lineup credit)
method.finish_percentile: 100 x (contest entries - real entries scoring more than the lineup) / contest entries: the share of the real field the lineup beats or ties, on the night's real points (the standings' FPTS, else the record's)
method.top10: the lineup's place (1 + real entries scoring more) within the contest's top 10% (ceil(0.1 x entries))
method.paired_difference: per contest: mean finish percentile of the treatment lineups minus that of the control lineups; per slate: the equal-weight mean over its contests (the primary metric). Top-10% rates are reported the same way, as a secondary
method.noise: SE of the nightly paired differences: their sample standard deviation / sqrt(nights)
method.pass_bar: after the planned nights: treatment ahead (slate difference > 0) on at least 7 of the 10 AND the pooled difference (the mean of the 10 slate differences) above 2 x noise. Verdict on the first 10 counted slates; later slates are shown but do not change it

experiments.name: STACK vs the plain game-group tags
experiments.treatment: kept lineups with a tag naming a quick stack: STACK <AWAY@HOME> <shape> (the DK page's stack quick buttons)
experiments.control: kept lineups with no STACK or GREENS tag whose tag's saved rules require 2+ players from one game's teams that a STACK lineup that slate stacked (a min rule with n >= 2 over players of that game only: the team tiles' Min 2/3 and Stack with buttons, a scan team or game stack, a hand rule)
experiments.primary_metric: mean real finish percentile difference (treatment - control), paired by slate and contest; top-10% rate shown
experiments.amended: 2026-11-24, before any counted slate: GREENS lineups (the game view's Set greens, from 2026-11-24) are out of the control

experiments.name: Scan floors vs group rules
experiments.treatment: kept lineups with a tag containing SCANFLOOR (drawn while Set floors from scan was on)
experiments.control: kept lineups with no SCANFLOOR or GREENS tag whose tag's saved rules hold a group rule: 'at least N of <players>' (template 5, the focus button, a scan team's Bank this)
experiments.primary_metric: mean real finish percentile difference (treatment - control), paired by slate and contest; top-10% rate shown
experiments.amended: 2026-11-24, before any counted slate: GREENS lineups (the game view's Set greens, from 2026-11-24) are out of the control

experiments.name: Draw the 9 cells vs L0 U0
experiments.treatment: each L x U cell other than L0 U0, separately: kept lineups tagged '<idea> L<lev> U<under>'
experiments.control: kept lineups tagged '<idea> L0 U0' for the same idea (only ideas that have both the cell and L0 U0 that slate)
experiments.primary_metric: mean real finish percentile difference (cell - L0 U0), paired by slate and contest; top-10% rate shown; one scoreboard row per cell

experiments.name: GREENS game groups vs hand-picked game groups
experiments.treatment: kept lineups with a tag containing GREENS <AWAY@HOME> (drawn under the DK page's Set greens: at least N of a game's green players by the checks)
experiments.control: kept lineups with no GREENS tag whose tag (itself free of GREENS, STACK and SCANFLOOR) holds the operator's own group rule: 'at least N of <players>' (template 5, the focus button, a scan team's Bank this, +set)
experiments.primary_metric: mean real finish percentile difference (treatment - control), paired by slate and contest; top-10% rate shown

experiments.name: Variants vs parents
experiments.treatment: every kept lineup the cut's Variants of the top step made (tagged 'variant of #N', grouped Variants of the top)
experiments.control: arm 'vs parents': each variant's own parent lineup, one to one (a parent with three variants counts three times); the parent from the build's variant_of (stored at creation from 2026-11-24), else the tag's #N read as the cut's keep position N, accepted only when it shares the variant's kept players (5 of 8 by default). Arm 'vs rest of top tenth': the top-tenth lineups that are not variants.
experiments.top_tenth: as the DK page's topTenth: the cut's kept lineups ranked by the idea board's sim value (cut_state.board.values, recomputed after variants join), the best min(kept, max(10, ceil(10% of kept)))
experiments.per_night: variant rounds run (cut_state.variantRounds; null before 2026-11-24), variants kept, top tenth size, variants in it and their share; the operator's working rule is one round a night, stopping past about a quarter of the top tenth
experiments.primary_metric: mean real finish percentile difference (treatment - control), paired by slate and contest (100+ entries); top-10% rate shown; each arm judged on its own
